FC-12.title: Figure C-12: RC2 Loose (printed C-34, PDF 148)
FC-12.legend_hint: the only group on this figure
FC-12.notes_for_reviewers: Computer-plotted failure envelope of RC2 soil (broadly graded crushed scoria), loose: shear strength against normal stress, one group of tests. The triangles (pointing up) are the tests; the straight line is the authors' least-squares fit and does not pass through every triangle. Both axis titles print (x 10^1): a tick printed 100.00 is 1000 psf. The box above the plot prints the group's values; they are not checked here. Where two triangles overlap, answer for the one nearest the crosshair, or cannot tell.
